race.title: Virgin Bet Every Saturday Money Back Wentworth Stakes (Listed)
race.verdict: COUL ANGEL steps up in grade but there has been a lot to like about his recent big-field handicap victories at the Curragh and York (form of both been well advertised ) and he looks very much the way to go. Copacabana Sands could emerge as the main threat if, as expected, building on a recent sixth in the Sceptre Stakes here, while Pellitory and Zen Diva can also have a say. Unique Journey completes the shortlist. COUL ANGEL (IRE) COPACABANA SANDS (IRE) PELLITORY
